description_sq:
Zona: Ofrohet per shitje apartament ne nje nga zonat me te preferuara te kryeqytetit - Bulevardi i Ri . Zona karakterizohet nga akses i shpejte ne rruget kryesore, qendren e qytetit, Unazen e Madhe, afersi me sherbimet, biznese, shkolla dhe transport publik, duke e bere kete nje mundesi ideale per banim ose investim.
Objekti: Pallati eshte ne ndertim dhe pritet te perfundoje per nje vit, me standarte te larta ndertimi dhe arkitekture moderne, fasade ventiluar. Objekti ofron siguri, organizim funksional, ashensor bashkekohor dhe ambient te qete banimi.
description_en: Area: An apartment is offered for sale in one of the most popular areas of the capital - New Boulevard. The area is characterized by quick access to the main roads, the city center, the Great Ring Road, proximity to services, businesses, schools and public transport, making this an ideal opportunity for residence or investment. Object: The palace is under construction and is expected to be completed in one year, with high construction standards and modern architecture, ventilated facade. The facility offers security, functional organization, modern elevator and quiet residential environment.
